summary.text: HJELMELAND HOGST & SERVICE AS is a private limited company registered in Seimsfoss, founded 2012-07-06. HJELMELAND HOGST & SERVICE AS is registered for timber and firewood felling, service and repair of forestry machines, agricultural equipment and construction machinery, purchase of hunting rights and sale of game meat, and guiding of guest hunters. Its main industry code is 02.100: silviculture and other forestry activities. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 22 328 132 NOK and the annual result was 7 149 140 NOK; operating income was up from 17 875 621 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 4 808 051 NOK in 2024 to 7 149 140 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 11 199 350 NOK in 2024 to 17 198 490 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 8 on 2026-02-13 to 7 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
